research_goal: optimizer-consistent all-109 Direct-TFV receding MPC under sparse causal sensing

core_pipeline.step1: causal sparse sensing -> current full-network hydraulic reconstruction
core_pipeline.step2: causal current state + causal rainfall + complete H360 reference/candidate actions -> authoritative exact delta TFV
core_pipeline.sequence_support: label-independent D3 TrainFit HOLD-reference q95 joint temporal trust region
core_pipeline.admission_calibration: fresh Development D3-HOLD rainfall groups not used by Step2 -> 90% one-sided rainfall-group split conformal; original Step2 D3 holdout -> independent cached audit; optimizer replay -> empirical maximum only
core_pipeline.step3: screen all 109; optimize and differentiably contract H120 sequence to q95 support; execute iff calibrated delta-TFV upper bound < 0 and first move changes
core_pipeline.swmm: authoritative offline label/evaluation/calibration truth only; never called inside online candidate search

action_contract.engineering_bounds: physical min/max plus <=0.5 setting movement per 10-minute update
action_contract.per_facility_support: TrainFit q95 first-move and sequence magnitude
action_contract.joint_temporal_support: D3-HOLD q95 first-block L1 mass, H120 L1 mass and H120 temporal total variation, enforced inside the differentiable decoder

admission_data_contract.preferred_fresh_calibration_rainfall_gro: 10-12 when generation cost is modest; preference is stability only, not a stronger coverage claim

scientific_bottleneck.mechanism_under_test: optimizer selection-induced optimism plus possible joint temporal sequence extrapolation
scientific_bottleneck.evidence: original D3 holdout has 32 branches but only 4 independent rainfall groups; 90% one-sided finite-sample conformal needs at least 9 calibration rainfall groups, so splitting that holdout into calibration plus audit is mathematically impossible
scientific_bottleneck.next_test: generate a small fresh Development-only D3-HOLD calibration pool, keep accepted Step2 V5 weights and original 4-rainfall-group holdout audit frozen, then resume V6

step3_current.active_support: q95 canonical; q90 conservative ablation; q99 diagnostic only

promotion_rule: first obtain valid fresh rainfall-disjoint admission calibration, then on fresh post-calibration Development events show zero support/engineering violations, reduced exact same-prefix false-beneficial rate and event-level no-control non-inferiority; only then reassess strong baselines and untouched Validation
